questions.prompt: If `number` is 20, what does this `switch` print?
questions.explanation: Case 20 prints its line, then `goto case 5` transfers control to the `case 5` label, which prints `case 5` and breaks.

questions.prompt: Which loop is exit controlled, so its body always runs at least once?
questions.explanation: `for` and `while` are entry controlled loops, while `do-while` is exit controlled: it checks the condition after the body, so it fits when the loop must execute at least once.

questions.prompt: According to the note, when is a `while` loop a better fit than a `for` loop?
options: When the number of iterations is unknown
When the number of iterations is known in advance
When you need to iterate over every item of an array
When the body must run at least once
questions.explanation: The note gives `for` for a known number of iterations and `while` for an unknown number; `foreach` is for collections and `do-while` for running at least once.
